Standing benchmark tracking with comparison machinery (issue #215). Benchmark-gated decisions (ADR 0003 action granularity, codegen milestone benchmarks, quality-testing permutation benchmarks) run here; a bare number without comparison is trivia, so this page publishes the committed baseline plus the comparison policy, never hand-written claims.

## Baseline

Calibrated 2026-09-17 on linux_x86_64 seed host, local execution, no remote (perf/bench.sh harness (EPOCHREALTIME bracketing, direct dx binary except cold via full bazel-run stack); micro median-of-7, scenario median-of-5, cold single-timing after `bazel shutdown`; 3x main runs combined (21 micro samples, 15 scenario samples, 3 cold samples)). Reference fixture: `//examples/adopt-rust/... (14-target foreign Cargo workspace, hermetic, generator-fresh)`. Bazel 9.2.0, commit `main @ 1fd5a3b (post #188)`. provisional generous absolutes set above 3x main noise; never guessed. Relative comparison stays advisory until months of stable signal, then promote per-benchmark.

## Policy

Comparison: per-PR runs compare median-of-N against baseline with tolerance band (relative + absolute floor against runner noise); regressions post a warn-only PR comment. Relative comparison stays advisory; only `gate:true` budgets fail (currently dx_startup only).

Baseline updates: human-merged PRs only; no bot commits (per repo automation policy). To recalibrate: run `bazel run //perf:bench_all` 3x on main, update baseline_ms via PR with evidence, regenerate docs via `bazel run //perf:regenerate`.

No `dx perf` command — Bazel targets plus docs (ADR 0006 minimal surface).

## Open benchmark-gated decisions

- ADR 0003 (action granularity) stays Provisional: this harness exists, but the package-vs-file-vs-repository alternative measurements are not recorded yet. Promotion to Accepted requires recorded evidence here.
- Codegen milestone benchmarks (`docs/environments/codegen.md`) and quality-testing permutation benchmarks (`docs/quality/quality-testing.md`) are pending scenario additions to this harness, not separate infrastructure.
- Relative comparison stays advisory until months of stable signal, then promote per-benchmark (strictness ladder).

## Running benchmarks

```sh
bazel build //dx/cli:dx //perf:bench_all
bazel run //perf:bench_micro > /tmp/micro.jsonl
bazel run //perf:bench_scenario_warm > /tmp/scenario.jsonl
python3 perf/compare.py --baseline perf/baseline.json /tmp/micro.jsonl /tmp/scenario.jsonl
```

Scenario cold runs (`generate_check_cold`) execute on `main` plus `workflow_dispatch` only (free-infra budget); microbenchmarks run per-PR. See `perf/README.md` and `.github/workflows/perf.yml`.
